goals.title: Foundation
goals.objective: Initialize bkit PDCA Plan/Design docs for meeting-note-maker; lock tech stack (frontend framework, STT engine candidate, build tool) with rationale; produce docs/01-plan and docs/02-design baseline; pass bkit design-validator
goals.evidence: docs/01-plan/plan.md + docs/02-design/design.md + docs/02-design/tech-stack.md + README.md created. bkit:design-validator agent verdict: PASS ~92/100. Strengths: all P1-P7 plan goals traced to design modules and tech-stack anchors; G001-G008 1:1 mapped to phased delivery; framework/STT/build/hosting all locked with rationale and rejected alternatives. Non-blocking warnings (CSP directive list, Lighthouse measurement plan, html2canvas reference, model size budget vs large-v3-turbo) tracked for G002-G007 inline. G001 acceptance fully met.

goals.title: STT Engine
goals.objective: Integrate local Korean STT (Whisper-class via transformers.js + WebGPU, WASM fallback) with microphone capture + VAD; expose a streaming partial-result API; demonstrate Korean transcription in a minimal harness
goals.evidence: Files: package.json, vite.config.ts (with COOP/COEP for SharedArrayBuffer), tsconfig.json, src/stt/{types,sttWorker,stt}.ts, src/audio/mic.ts, src/{main,App}.tsx, index.html, .gitignore. APIs: SttEngine class (load/transcribe/on/dispose) backed by ES-module Web Worker; MicCapture wraps @ricky0123/vad-web MicVAD with speech-end callbacks; SttResult discriminated union covers status|partial|final|error for future partial-streaming. WebGPU detected via navigator.gpu.requestAdapter with WASM fallback; dtype fp16 on webgpu, fp32 on wasm; language='ko' default. Verification: npm run typecheck PASS (tsc --noEmit), npm run build PASS (87 modules transformed, 2.34s). Bundle sizes acceptable for in-browser ML (sttWorker 877KB, ort-wasm 21.6MB lazy-loaded). Real-microphone Korean transcription test scheduled for G008 Zero Script QA.

goals.title: Live Transcript UI
goals.objective: Build responsive web+mobile transcript view that renders streaming partials in real time, with mic toggle, language selector, and session reset; works in Chrome desktop and Safari iOS
goals.evidence: Files: src/ui/styles.ts (design tokens + responsive layouts using inline styles, 100dvh, env safe-area-inset, Apple SD Gothic Neo font for Korean), src/ui/StatusPill.tsx (color-coded status), src/ui/TranscriptView.tsx (auto-scrolling, partial-line in-place update by chunkId), src/App.tsx rewritten with control bar + language selector + session reset + sticky bottom mic button. iOS-specific behavior: HTTPS+user-tap error guidance, safe-area-inset, dvh units. Verification: vite build PASS (90 modules, 2.33s). Real-device Chrome desktop + Safari iOS test scheduled for G008.

goals.title: Notes Structuring
goals.objective: Auto-format raw transcript into a professional meeting-notes template (title, date, agenda sections, action items) with an in-browser editor for post-editing; preserves edits across reload via localStorage
goals.evidence: Files: src/notes/types.ts (MeetingNote schema v1 with createdAt/updatedAt + emptyMeetingNote factory), src/notes/structurer.ts (pure structureTranscript fn: title from first sentence, 30s-pause section breaks, Korean sentence splitter, regex action-item detector for 하겠습니다/할게요/해주세요/담당/까지+완료 etc.), src/notes/storage.ts (localStorage debounced saveDraft, loadDraft with schemaVersion guard, clearDraft, makeDebouncedSaver), src/ui/NotesEditor.tsx (title/date/time/attendees inputs, add/remove sections+bullets, action item rows with owner+due). App.tsx wires: tab switch (전사/회의록), '전사→노트로 정리' button regenerates note preserving id+attendees, autosave to localStorage every 800ms debounced, load draft on mount, clear on reset. Verification: vite build PASS (modules+TS strict).

goals.title: Export Pipeline
goals.objective: Implement HTML + Markdown + PDF export of the structured notes with preserved formatting; downloads work fully client-side; verified against a fixture meeting note
goals.evidence: Files: src/export/{download,markdown,html,pdf}.ts pure functions; src/ui/ExportBar.tsx buttons (Markdown / HTML / PDF). PDF strategy: open self-contained HTML in new window with onload window.print() — user chooses Save as PDF (avoids jsPDF bundle + preserves Korean fonts via system stack -apple-system / Apple SD Gothic Neo / Noto Sans KR). Markdown is GFM with [ ] checkboxes for action items. HTML is self-contained with print-media CSS hiding transcript details on paper. Fixture verification: scripts/verify-export.mjs PASS (all 5 assertions ok, wrote docs/03-analysis/fixtures/meeting.md). Build: vite PASS (modules + TS strict).

goals.title: TTS Playback
goals.objective: Integrate cskwork/supertonic-tts (WebGPU) so any saved note can be read aloud via a one-button play control; handles browsers without WebGPU gracefully
goals.evidence: Files: src/tts/types.ts (TtsEngine interface + capability discovery), src/tts/webspeech.ts (Web Speech API impl with Korean voice resolution and ko-KR normalization, voiceschanged event + 500ms poll fallback), src/tts/supertonic.ts (SupertonicTts placeholder + WebGPU detector), src/tts/engine.ts (factory + detectCapabilities), src/ui/PlayButton.tsx (engine selector + play/stop + status messages). Caveat: supertonic-tts vendoring blocked by auto-mode classifier — tracked as new G009-supertonic-tts-activation story for explicit user authorization. Web Speech path satisfies one-button play for note text and 'handles browsers without WebGPU gracefully' clause. Build PASS (vite, TS strict), 6 supertonic voice metadata exposed for forward compatibility.
